assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Road network density 5.4 km/km² is a planning target, NOT recomputed from public data.
assumptions.basis: No official road-centerline GIS is in the public site package; 5.4 km/km² is the design goal for the overall design area (11.4 km²).
assumptions.formula: sum(road_centerline_length_m) / site_area_sqm * 1e-3 (to be recomputed once official road GIS is provided)
assumptions.impact: Do not cite 5.4 km/km² as an official metric; treat as target until recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Total building volume 18.80M m² (retained 12.0M + new 6.8M) is an UNVERIFIED SCENARIO with an arithmetic conflict: building_footprint_area_sqm (310,807 m²) × FAR 4.0 ≈ 1.243M m², which does not equal the retained 12.0M m². All three figures are to be re-derived after official floor-area census and FAR control are published.
assumptions.basis: Retained 12.0M m² is an estimate (existing footprints × hypothetical FAR 4.0); new 6.8M is a planning increment awaiting official FAR control.
assumptions.formula: retained_existing + new_increment (to be recomputed once official FAR control and floor-area census are published)
assumptions.impact: Do not treat 12.0M / 6.8M / 18.80M as computable metrics. Mark as unverified scenarios until official data.

assumptions.statement: Public service coverage 85% (5-minute life circle) is a planning target, NOT recomputed from public data.
assumptions.basis: Actual coverage requires official facility GIS and population distribution, both absent from the public package.
assumptions.formula: households_within_5min_life_circle / total_households (to be recomputed once official facility GIS is provided)
assumptions.impact: Do not cite 85% as an official metric; treat as design goal until recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Blue-green space ratio target 15.5% is a design goal; current computed green_ratio is 12.34% and public_space_ratio 7.33% on provisional geometry.
assumptions.basis: Computed green_ratio / public_space_ratio derive from submitted provisional geometry; the 15.5% target combines green + water + public space pending field survey.
assumptions.formula: (green + water + public space) / site_area_sqm (to be revised once field survey data is available)
assumptions.impact: Do not cite 15.5% as an official metric; treat as target until field survey.

assumptions.statement: All area and ratio values in metrics.json are based on the submitted geometry (provisional boundary derived from public data), NOT the official boundary.
assumptions.basis: Official boundary polygons are not provided in the public site package (DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605 is provisional_only).
assumptions.impact: Any area/ratio figure may change after the official boundary is published; recalculation method documented in metrics.json.
